name: Sky Reader Phase 7 Evaluation Benchmark Dataset
description: Structured evaluation dataset for benchmarking weather intelligence systems across 10 categories: current weather, hourly forecasts, comparisons, precipitation, trends, multi-step questions, evidence-based reasoning, safety/risks, missing data handling, and hallucination resistance.
